name: video-reader
description: Fetch, transcribe and read ONE video of any length from a URL (any site yt-dlp supports) or a local file, and report what is said and visible, never what is guessed. One entry script runs a metadata preflight, acquires the media with provenance, picks the caption track in the original language (English companion kept), falls back to a local whisper.cpp build it already finds, samples at most 120 frames by input seek plus scene cuts into indexed contact sheets, and keeps chapters. Follow-ups use dense frame windows and close-ups without a second download. No limits by default; nothing authenticates, nothing is installed, nothing leaves the machine.
